projects.title: TIC TAC TOE
projects.description: A classic Tic Tac Toe game built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Features a clean board, win detection, a reset button, and an option to play against a computer.

projects.title: Time Waster
projects.description: A vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript endurance game. Click anywhere before the 20-second countdown reaches zero to reset it and keep your session going; an elapsed-time counter and animated progress ring track your run. After game over, click to restart, and try to beat your personal best, saved in the browser with localStorage.

projects.title: web-shop
projects.description: A full-stack web shop built with Express, EJS, MySQL and Bootstrap. Browse a database-backed product catalogue, view product details and manage a cart saved in the browser; an admin interface supports adding, editing and deleting products. The checkout is a demonstration flow rather than payment processing.

projects.title: Hinnapõx
projects.description: A cross-platform fuel and electricity price companion built with React Native, Expo and TypeScript. Compare petrol, diesel and electricity prices, explore recent price-history charts, and find nearby fuel stations on a map with location-aware navigation and brand filters. Includes language and light/dark theme settings.

projects.title: React Movie Management
projects.description: A React movie-list manager built with Vite. Add and edit movies with a title, release year, genre and rating, then filter the collection by year. React Context manages the list and localStorage keeps it available between visits.

projects.title: Cybersecurity Game
projects.description: A React-based cybersecurity quiz game inspired by a televised prize ladder. Choose an easy, medium or hard starting level, answer timed questions that grow more challenging, and build your score toward the top reward. Each question has a 60-second limit, and game results are saved locally in a play history; Google sign-in can associate history with an account.
